summary: This document defines a way to carry call control User-to-User Information (UUI) in SIP, a small piece of data an application attaches when starting a session. It defines a SIP header field for the data and the rules for its use.

eli5.summary: When you call someone, a short note can ride along with the ring. This document says how to attach that note to a SIP call and how to read it.

questions: how to send user-to-user information in sip
